input.summary: parts/room-14.mjs furnishes the master bedroom: blue carpet, dresser chests on the west wall, white bed with headboard on the south wall, stair-chair group round a fence-and-slab table by the east hearth, and three hanging lanterns plus a standing lamp on the dresser.
left: In the real build the master bedroom places 0 blocks: runParts refuses all 84 writes (`REFUSED 84 writes into earlier parts`). Cause is shell.mjs (not my module): its box() fills the whole room with solid WALL, and the interior air carve counts as placed, so every interior cell is locked. Fix in the shell: write only the wall ring and leave interior cells unset. Logged in plan.md Notes.

Verified only in a scratch copy (/tmp/p21-test, shell line 26 changed to a wall-ring fill): the room places 84 blocks, light min 7 with 0 dark cells and 6 dim, FIT OK. The walk verdict is UNREACHABLE in both runs, because the upper hall, the doorway openings and the stairs are still stubs. Route lanes: z45 row, x54..55 column from the south doorways; they are free of furniture on the floor grid.
The chimney hearth (roofs part) is not built yet. The seating group at x58..59 z46..47 assumes the firebox opens onto x60, and x61..62 z46..47 is left alone; recheck once roofs lands.
plan.md checklist and elements.md not ticked: the master bedroom is not in the real build yet.

waste.cost: about 20 min of coordinate work across layers and bed() calls
waste.tool: `mcd plan` could emit the furniture as a legend-to-blocks text layout that `layers()` takes directly, so the room designer only fills in characters.

waste.what: Diagnosing the lock: a scratch copy of the whole part dir, patched by hand, to tell a shell fault from a furniture fault
waste.cost: 3 extra build cycles and a sed patch
waste.tool: `runParts` could report which earlier part placed the refused cell (shell box fill / carve), not just the coordinates and 'air'.
